sources.title: syntropic-clx/Clyx_0.3-NM-BASE · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Clyx is an independent language-model project built around a custom decoder-only Transformer. The next planned BASE model targets approximately 635.51 million parameters, using Grouped-Query Attention, RoPE, RMSNorm, and SwiGLU.

sources.title: Syntropic - The AI Efficiency Layer
sources.snippet: The AI Efficiency Layer. An invisible software layer that compresses KV cache load and reduces memory overhead — across text, image, audio, and video. No retraining. No weight changes. Built for production inference.
